name: appsphyton-fastfood
description: Scripts de orquestación — ejecutar desde backend/ o frontend/

scripts.backend:install: cd backend && python -m venv venv && .\venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.test: npm run backend:test && npm run frontend:test
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run backend:dev" "npm run frontend:dev"
scripts.e2e: npx wait-on -t 120000 http://127.0.0.1:5173 http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/health && cd e2e && npm test
scripts.e2e:install: cd e2e && npm install && npx playwright install chromium
